data.exact_reserve_text: The 2014 and prior underwriting years produced a profit of GBP 25,887k (2013 & prior: loss GBP 34,891k). This profit compares to a forecast profit of GBP 3,667k at 31 December 2015. The result has benefited from better than expected investment income and profits on exchange. In addition, the claims development on the Property, Special Lines and Liability accounts on the older years of account has been better than expected.

data.standardized_narrative: For the 2016 financial year, Syndicate 1206 experienced a gross prior year reserve strengthening of GBP 2.951 million, primarily driven by adverse claims development on underwriting years 2011, 2012, and 2014, partially offset by a release on 2013. This contradicts the narrative on page 1 which states that 'claims development on the Property, Special Lines and Liability accounts on the older years of account has been better than expected', contributing to a net profit for the 2014 and prior underwriting years.

data.data_quality_notes: There is a contradiction between the calculated gross prior year development from the claims triangle (+GBP 2.951m strengthening) and the narrative on page 1 stating 'claims development on the Property, Special Lines and Liability accounts on the older years of account has been better than expected' which implies a release. The gross claims development figure from the triangle is used as per instructions. The 'profit of GBP 25,887k' for 2014 and prior years mentioned on page 1 is a net year-of-account result, including investment income and exchange, and is not used as the primary prior year development figure.
